sources.title: PlanToys Company Overview, Contact Details & Competitors | LeadIQ
sources.snippet: PlanToys is a manufacturing company located in Bangkok, Thailand, employing 11-50 people. The company produces educational toys for various developmental stages, emphasizing environmental and social responsibility and high ethical standards. PlanToys uses non-toxic, natural materials such as organic rubberwood in its products to promote safe play and a closer connection to nature. The company maintains in-house safety standards in addition to industry norms and pursues environmentally safe, [...] safe, sustainable production methods. PlanToys' toys have been recognized with awards in the educational toy sector, including the Parents' Choice Award and the Oppenheim Toy Portfolio Award. The company's website is plantoysusa.com.
